categories.main_business_segments: Maxic Technology focuses on high-performance analog and mixed-signal chips, with a dual-engine product matrix of power management and signal chain products. Core products include wireless charging chips, lighting driver chips, wired fast charging chips, signal chain optical sensors, and automotive electronics. The company targets strategic platforms in mobile phones, automobiles, and robotics, serving communication terminals, smart homes, automotive electronics, and expanding into industrial control, low-altitude flight, and AI markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies including PD/SPAD photodiode processes, VCSEL devices, coating technologies, and high-voltage BCD integrated processes (700V and 100V BCD). It integrates system-level SoC design combining analog and digital mixed-signal circuits with embedded algorithms, optical system design, and packaging. Manufacturing follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized partners while maintaining in-house R&D and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global brands in smartphones, smart wearables, automotive electronics, and industrial control, such as Brand A, Honor, Samsung, Transsion, Vivo, DJI, Stone, Dreame, OPPO, Xiaomi, Anker, Signify, Ledvance, Foshan Lighting, Li Auto, and BYD. The company serves end markets in communication terminals, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial lighting, smart homes, and emerging sectors like AIoT, robotics, and low-altitude economy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, complemented by growing overseas sales. It has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Xiamen, Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Xi'an to support R&D and sales. Overseas sales have increased notably, reflecting expanding international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Maxic Technology operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries and subcontractors. It maintains strategic partnerships with leading domestic wafer fabs and packaging/testing providers, ensuring supply chain stability and cost efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, dedicating over 40% of revenue to research and development, focusing on advancing high-integration analog and mixed-signal chips, optical sensing technologies, wireless charging, automotive-grade products, and AI sensor integration. It aims to enhance product performance, expand product lines, and accelerate commercialization in strategic areas such as signal chain sensors, wireless charging, automotive electronics, and AIoT applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuits, including analog power management chips, wireless charging chips, and signal chain optical sensors. The company sells mainly via a combination of distributor-based wholesale and direct sales to key customers, employing a buyout sales model with distributors and direct contracts with strategic clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Maxic Technology is positioned as a leading domestic analog and mixed-signal chip design company with strong technical capabilities and a growing presence in high-value segments like automotive and optical sensors. It competes against international semiconductor giants in high-end markets but leverages its proprietary technologies and localized supply chain to advance domestic substitution and capture emerging market opportunities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 404 million, a 14.43% decline year-over-year, primarily due to market price pressures and customer product cycle adjustments. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 66.57 million, reflecting increased R&D investment and market challenges. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.997 billion with equity of RMB 1.889 billion. Despite short-term profit decline, the company is investing heavily in R&D and expanding product lines to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Maxic Technology emphasizes its system-level integration capabilities combining analog and digital mixed-signal design with proprietary optical and power management technologies. Its products offer high sensitivity, precision, and dynamic range, often surpassing international benchmarks. The company’s vertical integration of core processes and supply chain, combined with tailored solutions for mobile, automotive, and robotics platforms, provides differentiated value through innovation, reliability, and domestic supply security.
